# Affiliate browser tags

Apply the [media contract](../../media/common.md) for the explicitly selected network/product.
The brief supplies commercial action, program/advertiser identity, environment and approved fields;
current network documentation supplies browser, template, basket and duplicate-control semantics.

## Establish the network architecture

Record exact network/program, region, installed supported implementation, base/journey/page needs,
existing site/plugin/partner owners, conversion/goal identity, cookie/link-decoration/attribution,
consent and cross-domain contract. Feed, voucher, commission-group, product-code and account activation
have separate external owners.

## Map commercial fields

Build exact source-to-template mappings for the selected fields:

- order/lead reference and network duplicate-control purpose;
- amount, tax, shipping, discount, commission/revenue basis and currency;
- voucher, new-customer/segment, program/campaign/publisher values;
- complete basket rows: network item ID, name/category, price, quantity and line amount;
- conversion type/group/goal.

Network meaning determines each field even where its label matches an analytics field. Apply
[mapping](../../data/mapping.md) for direct/projection selection and complete cardinality. The approved
stable reference serves browser duplicate control where the network documents that use.

## Coordinate and verify ownership

Reconcile GTM, site code, ecommerce/affiliate modules, template automation and platform rules.
Select one conversion owner with explicit page/dataLayer timing, refresh/revisit, SPA and firing
behavior. Existing-path changes use their authorized update/remove action. Verify program identity,
commercial fields, complete basket, initialization, duplicate-control and consent in the saved graph.
Attribution/commission computation and network receipt require external evidence.

## Server route

For partner postbacks/server pixels, load [Server](server.md) with the exact official partner contract.
